# Pull request

## Summary

What changed and why?

## Validation

How was this checked?

For text-only changes, a manual review may be sufficient.

## Checks

- [ ] Internal links use relative URLs.
- [ ] `npx markdownlint-cli2` passes for changed Markdown files.
- [ ] `lychee --offline` passes, if links were changed.
- [ ] No universal registry, HPET, BCD, service-disabling, or protection-disabling advice was added.
- [ ] Any new recommendation includes applicability, risks, verification, and rollback.
- [ ] No unrelated files or uncommitted changes were included.
